title: 2 Homes w Gameroom + 2 Rooftops
description:
Welcome to Whiskey Row Retreat — two downtown Nashville homes under one address, built for groups that go big. 36 beds, 8 bedrooms, and two private rooftops with skyline views make it the right fit for bachelor parties, bachelorette weekends, birthdays, and family trips. Kick back in the open-concept living space, head up to the rooftop, and walk to Broadway's honky-tonks in minutes. Steps from the Ryman, Bridgestone, and every downtown hotspot.

The space
Whiskey Row Retreat is two downtown Nashville homes under one roof — plenty of room for the whole crew without splitting up. The setup works well for wedding parties, family reunions, birthday trips, corporate getaways, or any group that needs more space than a single rental offers.

Both sides feature modern decor, open layouts, and plenty of room to spread out. Each home has a comfortable living area that connects to a fully equipped kitchen with an island — a natural hangout spot for group meals, movie nights, or pregaming before a night on Broadway.

Upstairs, each side opens to its own private rooftop with lounge seating and skyline views — a great spot for sunsets, group photos, or gathering the crew before heading out.

You can book one side for a smaller group or the whole property for a larger one.

Sleeping: 36 Beds / 4 Bathrooms 

Unit A: 18 Beds

Bedroom 1 - 6 single beds

Bedroom 2 - 2 full beds

Bedroom 3 - 4 single beds

Bedroom 4 - 2 full beds

   +4 foldable single beds

Unit B: 18 Beds

Bedroom 1 - 6 single beds

Bedroom 2 - 1 single, 1 full, 1 queen

Bedroom 3 - 2 queen, 1 full, 1 single

Bedroom 4 - 1 King

   +4 foldable single beds

Guest access
Guests have full private access to the entire home, all floors, the game room and the private rooftop deck. 

Free street parking is included. 

Self check-in via smart lock means you arrive on your schedule — no meet-and-greet required. Luggage drop and Early Check In is welcome for early arrivals and late departures (just message us to coordinate)

Other things to note
Neighborhood

You're staying in the heart of downtown Nashville — right in the middle of Music City, with Broadway's lights, live music, and energy just minutes from your front door. The area is walkable and active day and night. From your door, you can stroll to live music venues, top restaurants, cocktail bars, and major Nashville landmarks without needing a car.

Nearby hotspots include:

- Lower Broadway and the Honky-Tonk Highway — under 1 mile
- Bridgestone Arena — under 1 mile
- Country Music Hall of Fame — under 1 mile
- Ryman Auditorium — about 1 mile
- Nissan Stadium — about 1.3 miles (via pedestrian bridge)
- The Gulch — 1.5 miles
- 12 South — about 2.5 miles
